subject: POC kickoff recap + quick check on activation timeline
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlens.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:12:00Z
Subject: POC kickoff recap + next steps (BrightLens)

Hey Alex — great call earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place of truth: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for your content-classification pipeline (throughput target ~300 reqs/min, 90ms p50).
- Success criteria (agreed): sample accuracy >= 92% on your labeled dev set; end-to-end latency below 150ms p95 for 512-token requests in staging; ability to sustain 10k tokens/min during stress test.

Action items:
1) BrightLens: share a sample of the labeled dataset (S3 link or upload to Drive) and confirm which fields we should preserve.
2) BrightLens (DevOps): complete the VPC peering request (see checklist) so we can route test traffic from your staging cluster.
3) Redwood: provision a 2-week POC sandbox, create API keys, and provide a short smoke-test script you can run.

I attached the POC mutual-action template and our lightweight setup checklist to make the onboarding quick. If you want, we can run a 30-minute "kickstart" session to walk through the checklist and run the first smoke test together. Monica will be on point for day-to-day onboarding.

Proposed kickoff window: Monday 6/15 — Wednesday 6/17. Tell me what works best and who from your engineering team will pair on the call.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: POC_MA_Template.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-setup-checklist.txt (text/plain)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlens.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@brightlens.ai
Date: 2026-06-11T10:14:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff recap + next steps (BrightLens)

Thanks Markus — useful recap. We pushed the dataset owner to upload a slice of the labeled data to the Drive link you provided (you should see it by EOD). On the infra side, we're blocked on a maintenance window for the VPC changes; DevOps asked to wait until next week (targeting 6/17 or 6/18).

Also, small heads-up: product is swapping priorities this week for a customer bug; I still want to run the POC but it might slip depending on when the maintenance window is approved. I'll confirm by 6/15.

Appreciate the checklist — will review and loop in the engineer who'll be on the call.

— Alex

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlens.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T13:40:00Z
Subject: Quick check — trial sandbox idle, can I help unblock?

Hi Alex — checking in quickly as I noticed no traffic from BrightLens in the sandbox and the last note mentioned the maintenance window. Wanted to see if you needed help moving the VPC work, or if you'd prefer we hold the sandbox until your engineering team is free. A few options that work on our side: 

- Quick pairing session (30–45 min) where Monica or I will help run the setup and first smoke test (we can take care of the parts that don't require your creds).
- We can perform a limited "proxy run" on sample data you approve so you can see the latency/accuracy numbers without peering (less representative but quick).
- Pause the POC start and extend the sandbox window by two weeks at no cost if priority shifted.

If timing is the issue, let me know what date you want us to aim for and we'll reschedule the kickoff. If you'd like the pairing session, share 2 slots next week and Monica will book.

If I don't hear back by EOD Friday (6/19) I'll follow up once more and then mark the POC as "on hold" in our CRM so we don't consume provisioned capacity. No pressure — just want to keep things efficient on both ends.

Thanks,
— Markus

Date: 2026-06-20T09:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: POC kickoff recap + quick check — recommendation on next step (internal)

Fwding the thread — Alex hasn't responded after the 6/16 check, and sandbox shows zero API calls. I'm proposing two options to discuss with you both: 

1) Offer a complimentary 2-week extension on the sandbox window and a small trial credit (10% seat discount equivalent) to keep BrightLens engaged, with an ask that they pick a new kickoff date within 30 days.
2) Mark the POC as "on hold" in CRM, free up reserved infra, but keep a templated re-engagement plan (email + 1:1 invite) to restart when they reopen.

My recommendation is option (1) if we want to preserve momentum — BrightLens indicated interest and has the dataset ready; the slip seems operational. If we do (1) I can send a short note today and include Monica for a pairing session.

Thoughts? If you approve option (1) can we also clear a one-time small credit from Finance and confirm with Monica we'll schedule the pairing?

— Markus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
